name: og-growth-alt-physical-reproduction
title: Physical Reproduction
question: Can an individual physically reproduce — grow to a division threshold and divide into daughters that grow and divide in turn — building a multi-generation lineage in the agents map, with matter and volume conserved at every division?
hypothesis: A founder individual whose division_state grows to threshold divides by a _divide structural rewrite that halves its matter and volume; the daughters inherit half each (their amounts and volumes sum to the mother's) and grow and divide in turn, so a >=3-generation lineage forms in the agents map with the partition residual 0 at every division.
objective: Drive AgentGrowthProcess -> DivisionStep over the agents map from a single founder; gate that the lineage reaches >=3 generations and that every _divide conserves matter and volume (daughter volumes sum to the mother's — partition residual 0, total volume constant).
proposed_mechanisms: H+: reproduction is a structural rewrite (_divide) on the agents map, not a counter
conserving partition (FMP §9.1) — daughters'' amounts + volumes sum to the mother''s
proposed_models_methods: AgentGrowthProcess (division_state -> threshold) + DivisionStep (_divide, matter + volume halved)
LineageStatsProcess (deepest generation, total volume) + RewriteLedgerProcess (partition residual)

conditions.name: partition_conservation
conditions.expr: partition_residual_max == 0 (daughter amounts + volumes sum to the mother)

behavior_tests.name: lineage-reaches-three-generations
behavior_tests.description: A founder individual grows and divides, its daughters grow and divide in turn, so the lineage in the agents map reaches at least 3 generations.

measure.detail: deepest generation the lineage REACHES (peak over the run, not the time-mean); from artifacts/physical_reproduction_report.json

behavior_tests.name: division-conserves-volume
behavior_tests.description: Every _divide conserves matter and volume — the daughters' volumes sum to the mother's, so the total volume is constant across the lineage and the partition residual is 0.

pass_if.detail: partition residual ~ 0 at every division (conserving split)

literature_anchors.relevance: the origin of a self-reproducing individual as the pre-genetic endpoint of the chemistry.

baseline.name: Founder lineage — growth to a >=3-generation lineage

claim: An individual physically reproduces by a _divide structural rewrite, building a >=3-generation lineage in the agents map with matter and volume conserved (partition residual 0) at every division.

findings.statement: A founder grows, divides, and its daughters do the same — a >=3-generation lineage forms in the agents map, matter and volume conserved at every division.

limitations: Growth is abstracted to the division trigger (division_state), not the full osmotic van der Waals growth of og-growth-division; coupling the two is the natural follow-up.
